subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous low-level runtime objects and helpers: texture-atlas region allocation from horizontal/vertical free-space lists, audio emitters and sound-manager instance lists, camera projection/view matrix updates, surface and resource locking with release helpers, bitmap file location and loading, scene-node release and recursive activity checks, and shadow-texture resource array lifecycle. The largest shared anchor is the global context object dword_8B78A0, which is passed as the first argument to surface, composition, resource-loading and sound calls and also carries a sub-buffer descriptor freed by SubBufferFree.

summary: DERIVED grouping of 21 validated IR functions around a few runtime object families. (1) Texture-atlas allocation (0x00540940) draws rectangular regions from sorted horizontal/vertical free-space lists, allocating 36-byte and 28-byte region nodes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and validating placements through 0x00540DF0 / 0x00540FC0. (2) An audio-emitter family (0x005426A0 / 0x00542E50) plus a texture-surface-set creator (0x005429B0), a two-phase stream allocator with fallback emitters (0x00543A80), and a sound-manager instance-list updater (0x00541810) all route through the global dword_8B78A0. (3) A graphics/resource object acquires buffer and surface-blit locks by flag bits (0x00540D40), with two mirror release helpers (0x00540F90 / 0x005410F0) invoking a virtual method at vtable offset +48. (4) Camera projection/view updates (0x00541B70), a bit-3 flag setter on this+0x80 (0x00541CA0), a rect-clip helper (0x00543540), and a constructor-style initializer (0x005418B0). (5) Bitmap location/loading (0x005427D0 / 0x00543050 / 0x00543130) and an argument-reordering dispatch wrapper (0x00543230). (6) Scene-graph helpers: node release (0x005437E0) and recursive activity check (0x00544E20), plus shadow-texture resource management (0x00544740) which tears down the dword_8B78A0 sub-buffer via 0x00541420. Owners are almost entirely UNKNOWN in the packet; AudioEmitter is the only DERIVED named owner. Contradiction kept explicit: dword_8B78A0 is labeled SoundManager in existing fills (DERIVED) yet is used as the rendering/resource context for surface, composition and bitmap calls, so it is modeled both as the SoundManager class base and as a RenderResourceContext interface.

function_roles.role: Allocates rectangular regions in a texture atlas from sorted horizontal/vertical free-space lists: allocates 36-byte horizontal and 28-byte vertical region nodes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, links them into doubly-linked lists keyed by remaining space, consumes space on fit, and reports aErrorCreatingV through 0x0053C590 with return -1 on validation failure; returns 0 on success.

Flag-driven lock acquisition on a graphics/resource object: when a2 bit 4 is set allocates a buffer lock via 0x00540F00(a1[7], a2, a1[11], a1[2]) stored at a1[8]; when a2 bit 8 is set allocates a surface blit lock via 0x00541090(a1[9], a2, a1[12], a1[4]) stored at a1[10]; the two branches are independent; no-op when a1 is null.

Release helper: when a2 and the object pointer at a2+32 are non-null, invokes the virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48, stores the return into *this, and decrements the counter at a2+20 when the return is zero.

Release helper mirror of 0x00540F90: when a2 and the object pointer at a2+24 are non-null, invokes the virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48, stores the return into *this, and decrements the counter at a2+12 when the return is zero.

Frees the sub-buffer descriptor at this+0x114C: resets the base allocation and base+36 via 0x00540EB0, frees the descriptor memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf at pointer-minus-4, and nulls the field; returns the last freed or read pointer. Shared teardown for 0x00544740 and 0x00544AF0.

Updates the sound instance ID list of a sound-manager object: when flag this+0x13D8 is non-zero, clears every existing instance (count this+0x155C, array this+0x1560) via the vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 with flag 0, then repopulates the array from a 56-byte-strided source (IDs at *(*(a3))+4) using the same vtable method with flag 1; returns the new instance count.

Constructor-style initializer: calls GlobalZeroInit_c2a0 to zero the whole object, then explicitly re-zeroes dwords at 0x80, 0x19C, 0x1B4 and 0x1B8 before returning this. Callers span unrelated subsystems so the owning object type is unknown.

Builds camera projection (orthographic when a2 bit 0x10 set, perspective otherwise) and view matrices gated by a2 bits (4=projection, 2=view, 8=additional sub_55CC20 update): reads near/far planes (this+4, this+8), fov (this+28), aspect (this+32) and a flag byte at this+128, and uploads matrices through EnumToVTableCallMapper (0x0055CA40).
Flag setter that sets or clears bit 3 (0x8) of the dword at this+0x80 based on boolean a2, stores the updated value back and returns it; invoked on render, scene-loading and subsystem-init paths.

Constructor-style initializer for an audio emitter: zero-initializes via GlobalZeroInit_c2a0, explicitly clears fourteen dwords at offsets 0x0..0x34, sets non-zero defaults this[11]=1 (0x2C) and this[12]=6 (0x30), and returns this.

Searches for a bitmap file on behalf of texture creation: copies and normalizes the path (truncating to 0x300 bytes), tests it directly via 0x00543130, then each registered data-directory entry (byte_8B5A3C, stride 132, dword_8B8E30) formatted with a %s path, and finally an object linked list headed by dword_8B8F14 via 0x0055FE70; when the found count differs from dword_8B6AC0 it logs 'Could not locate bitmap file %s' through 0x0053C590 and returns -1.

Creates a texture surface set on this from an audio-emitter-backed source using the global context dword_8B78A0: gated on (a6 & 0xF), allocates and configures primary/secondary AudioEmitter objects, binds bitmap or stream sources, registers them with the sound manager, generates MIP-level filenames, and creates one DirectX surface per set channel mode via 0x0053FD40; returns 0 on success and -1 after cleanup on every failure path.

Destructor/reset path for an audio emitter: unregisters from the global context dword_8B78A0 via 0x0053FB80 (logging 'Error deallocating' through 0x0053C590 and returning -1 on failure), drains and frees the buffer at field 0x4, zeroes all state fields, resets the mode field 0x30 to 6 and returns 0.

Loads a bitmap file into a freshly allocated buffer and hands the raw bytes to RenderingCompositionSetup (0x0053FED0) on the global context dword_8B78A0; returns 0 on success, -1 on setup failure, and -2 with 'Error opening bitmap file %s' logged through 0x0053C590 when the file cannot be opened.

Structural twin of BitmapFileLoader: loads a file into an allocated buffer and hands it to ResourceLoadWithOutput (0x00540050) on the global context dword_8B78A0 where a2/a3/a4 are output parameters; returns 0 on success, -1 on load failure, and -2 with 'Error opening bitmap file %s' through 0x0053C590 when the file cannot be opened.

Argument-reordering wrapper: forwards this (as int) and a3/a2 swapped to BitmaskVirtualDispatch (0x00540150) and returns the dispatch result unchanged; the global dword_8B78A0 is read somewhere in the dispatch path but not in this function's visible body.

Thiscall rectangle-clipping helper: clips two coordinate/extent pairs (a2 with a4, a3 with a5) against surface bounds read from this+0x1C and this+0x20, folding negative coordinates into extents and clamping so coordinate plus extent stays within the bound; returns a5.
Releases a scene-graph node: unconditionally calls 0x0053CAF0 on the child-node pointer at this+0x110, then calls the no-op stub; called from MutexSemaphoreCleanup (0x005461B0).

Two-phase audio emitter allocation with fallback: when flag this+0xEC bit 0x4 is clear, allocates and registers two 60-byte AudioEmitter objects into globals dword_8B8DBC/dword_8B8DC0 via 0x00542950, runs primary stream init via 0x0055B6B0, retaining the fallbacks (OR bit 0x10800 into this+0xEC) when primary init fails or releasing them when it succeeds.

Manages the lifecycle of a shadow-texture resource array on this: gated by flag bit 0x100000 of this+0xEC (must be clear) and a positive requested count at this+0x158, destroys existing 96-byte items (count this+0x160, array this+0x164) before reallocation, names each item SHADOWTEXnnn, creates its surface via 0x00542950, submits the array via 0x00547860, then drains two dependent-object priority queues (heads this+0x100, this+0x108) and a flag-check list (head this+0x148); also tears down the dword_8B78A0 sub-buffer via 0x00541420.

Recursive tree-activity check: recurses on child pointers at this+0x44 and (gated by flag a2) this+0x4C, walks a sibling list headed at this+0x204 following the next pointer at node+0x10, and returns -1 when a sibling node satisfies SceneNodeChildrenClear (0x0054D030) or a recursion reports true; returns 0 when the list is exhausted.

classes.name: TextureAtlasAllocator
classes.responsibility: Allocates rectangular regions in a texture atlas from sorted horizontal/vertical free-space lists; keeps list heads, a secondary dimension, a request anchor and an allocator-enabled flag. Node layout ownership is ambiguous so region-node fields are modeled on the deterministic derived bases.

classes.name: AtlasFreeListNode
classes.responsibility: Free-space region node used by the atlas allocator's horizontal/vertical lists: carries next/back links, a bound, a current offset and a region id. Layout is ambiguous from the packet; offsets are kept on the deterministic base *(this+0x1154) as GUESS.

classes.name: AtlasRequestNode
classes.responsibility: Request-side region node anchored through *(this+0x118C)+0x14: carries flags, a width and a height for the requested atlas region plus a next link. Base is the deterministic derived anchor; the packet does not prove this is the same type as the free-list nodes.

classes.name: AudioEmitter
classes.responsibility: Audio emitter object: constructed via GlobalZeroInit with a non-zero default on 0x2C and a mode default of 6 on 0x30; on teardown it unregisters from the global context dword_8B78A0, drains/frees its buffer at 0x4 and zeroes its state fields. The only named DERIVED owner in the packet.

classes.name: SoundManager
classes.responsibility: Sound-manager object owning a sound engine pointer (this+0x1100), an instance-update enable flag (this+0x13D8), and an instance-count / instance-ID-array pair (this+0x155C / this+0x1560); updates its instance list through a vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8. The identity of this object with the global dword_8B78A0 is not proven; the packet only anchors instance-list behavior here.

classes.name: Camera
classes.responsibility: Camera object with near/far planes, field of view, aspect and a flag byte; builds projection (orthographic/perspective) and view matrices and uploads them through the matrix upload dispatcher. The view matrix read at this+348 is described by the packet but carries no field evidence ref, so no field entry is made for it.

classes.name: RenderStateFlags
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a bitmask flag field at this+0x80 whose bit 3 is toggled by callers across render, scene-loading and subsystem-init paths. The offset 0x80 is shared with the Camera flag byte but common ownership is not proven, so this is modeled separately.

classes.name: SurfaceLockOwner
classes.responsibility: Graphics/resource object holding a buffer pointer, a surface pointer, lock control/sizing fields and the lock-result slots; acquires buffer and surface-blit locks based on flag bits of the requested mask.

classes.name: LockReleaseHelper
classes.responsibility: Release helpers that invoke a virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48 on a wrapped object and decrement a counter when it returns zero, storing the return into the caller's result slot. The two variants differ in wrapped-object offset (+32 and counter +20 versus +24 and counter +12) so their a2 layouts are treated as distinct.

classes.name: SubBufferOwner
classes.responsibility: Object carrying a sub-buffer descriptor at this+0x114C; SubBufferFree resets its base allocation and base+36 then frees the descriptor memory and nulls the field. Called with the global context dword_8B78A0 as this, suggesting the global itself owns a sub-buffer.

classes.name: BitmapResourceLoader
classes.responsibility: Locates and loads bitmap files: normalizes and tests candidate paths across data directories and a global object list, loads file bytes into allocated buffers, and hands them to rendering-composition or resource-load consumers; shares the 'Error opening bitmap file %s' and 'Could not locate bitmap file %s' diagnostic paths through the error reporter.

classes.name: TextureSurfaceSet
classes.responsibility: Texture surface set created from an audio-emitter-backed source: commits flags (this+0x18), dimensions (this+0x1C, this+0x20), MIP count (this+0x2C) and an audio source field (this+0x34), and drives per-channel DirectX surface creation. Field roles are DERIVED from usage only.

classes.name: BitmaskDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Thin argument-reordering dispatcher that forwards to BitmaskVirtualDispatch (0x00540150); the wrapper swaps its second and third parameters before dispatch.

classes.name: RectClipOwner
classes.responsibility: Object exposing surface bounds (width this+0x1C, height this+0x20) used to clip rectangle coordinates/extents; roles carried over from existing fills as DERIVED, not independently proven.

classes.name: SceneNode
classes.responsibility: Scene-graph node with child pointers (this+0x44, this+0x4C), a released child-node pointer (this+0x110), and a sibling list headed at this+0x204 whose nodes carry a next pointer at +0x10. Grouping the release function and the activity check into one class is structural inference, not proven common ownership.

classes.name: AudioStreamAllocator
classes.responsibility: Allocates audio emitter streams with a fallback pair of globally-held emitters (dword_8B8DBC/dword_8B8DC0), gated by flag bits of this+0xEC; retains the fallbacks when primary stream initialization fails.

classes.name: ShadowTextureResourceAllocator
classes.responsibility: Manages a shadow-texture resource array on this: gated by flag bit 0x100000 of this+0xEC and the requested count at this+0x158, allocates 96-byte items with a count header, names and creates their surfaces, submits them to the renderer, and drains two dependent-object priority queues and a flag-check list.

state_machines.name: ShadowResourceLifecycle
transitions: Teardown clears flag bit 0x100000 of this+0xEC, returning the allocator to Unloaded
Commit sets flag bit 0x100000 of this+0xEC after the array survives, entering Loaded
Allocation requires the flag bit clear and this+0x158 > 0

state_machines.name: AudioStreamFallbackState
transitions: When primary init returns 0, OR bit 0x10800 into this+0xEC and retain both fallback emitters
On primary success, release and free each fallback emitter handle and zero the globals

interfaces.name: RenderResourceContext
interfaces.purpose: Global rendering/resource context object (dword_8B78A0) passed as the first argument to surface-creation, composition-setup and resource-loading calls. Its identity as SoundManager is contested (see summary); this interface records only the observed first-argument contract.

interfaces.name: MatrixUploadDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Uploads matrices to the renderer through an enum-to-vtable mapping: EnumToVTableCallMapper(4, matrix) for the projection matrix and EnumToVTableCallMapper(2, matrix) for the view matrix.

interfaces.name: VirtualReleaseSlot
interfaces.purpose: Virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48 invoked by the release helpers on their wrapped object; its return value being zero triggers a counter decrement. No concrete address is evidenced in the packet.

interfaces.name: BitmaskDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Bitmask-driven virtual dispatch entry point (BitmaskVirtualDispatch 0x00540150) reached through argument-reordering wrappers such as 0x00543230; the dispatch semantics selected by the bitmask are unknown.

interfaces.name: SoundEngineInstanceList
interfaces.purpose: Vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 that manages sound instance IDs: mode flag 0 removes/clears an instance, mode flag 1 adds/starts an instance. Concrete address not evidenced.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextureAllocationErrorConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: Texture and resource creation returns 0 on success and -1 on any allocation, file, registration or surface-creation failure; bitmap loaders additionally return -2 when the file cannot be opened, after logging 'Error opening bitmap file %s' (string 0x005DBDEC) through the error reporter 0x0053C590. A replacement must preserve these distinct failure codes.

compatibility_contracts.name: AtlasAllocationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Texture-atlas allocation allocates regions from horizontal and vertical free-space lists and validates placements with 0x00540DF0 / 0x00540FC0; when a placement validation fails the allocator reports the aErrorCreatingV message (string 0x005DBD40) through the error reporter and returns -1, otherwise 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: SoundInstanceListContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Sound-manager instance lists are updated by clearing all existing entries (vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 with mode flag 0) and repopulating from a 56-byte-strided source taking each ID at +4 (mode flag 1); the instance count lives at this+0x155C and the ID array at this+0x1560, gated by the flag at this+0x13D8.

compatibility_contracts.name: LockReleaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Release helpers call a virtual __stdcall method at vtable offset +48 on a wrapped object; when the call returns zero the owning counter is decremented (a2+20 in the buffer variant, a2+12 in the guarded variant) and the call result is stored into the caller's result slot at this+0.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShadowResourceGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Shadow-texture array allocation is gated by flag bit 0x100000 of this+0xEC (clear to allocate, set marks resources loaded) and by a positive requested count at this+0x158; the loaded flag and item count at this+0x160 are committed together after successful array submission.

unresolved: Read-only allocator fields at this+0x1178, this+0x117C and this+0x1180 are not referenced by any visible decompiled body; their role in the atlas allocator/request object is unknown.

The exact atlas node layout (which offsets belong to the horizontal 36-byte node versus the vertical 28-byte node versus the list heads) is ambiguous; the deterministic bases *(*(this+0x118C)+0x14) and *(this+0x1154) were kept as-is and modeled as separate GUESS classes.
The meaning of the flag bits in the lock-acquisition mask (4 = buffer lock, 8 = surface blit lock) and of the other bits of a2 is not documented in the packet.

The vtable method at offset +48 invoked by 0x00540F90 and 0x005410F0 has no concrete address; the two helpers also use different wrapped-object layouts (+32/counter+20 versus +24/counter+12) so their a2 structures are treated as distinct even though the helpers are mirror twins.

Four dereferenced-field facts from the deterministic store are not visible in the raw decompiled body of 0x00544740: *(*(this+0x1EC)+0x4C), *(this+0x154)+0x4C, *(this+0x1B0)+0x68 and *(this+0x204)+0x104. The last resembles the +104 next-pointer walk of the flag-check list, but its base (this+0x204) differs from the list head at this+0x148, so it is not assigned to an operation.

The identity of the global context dword_8B78A0 is contested: existing fills label it SoundManager (DERIVED), yet it is passed as the rendering/resource context to surface, composition, resource-loading and sound calls and carries the sub-buffer descriptor freed by 0x00541420. It is modeled both as the SoundManager class base and as a RenderResourceContext interface; this contradiction is not resolved by the packet.
Globals 0x0059E420 (double 1.0), 0x008B78A0 and 0x008B8F24 are read by 0x00541B70 per the fact table, but the read sites are not visible in the Hex-Rays pseudocode.
The Camera view matrix read at this + 348 is described by the packet summary but carries no field evidence reference, so no class field entry is made for it.

The owning object of 0x005418B0 (constructor initializer) is unknown; its four caller addresses span unrelated subsystems and the semantic role of the four re-zeroed fields beyond GlobalZeroInit is not established.

0x00543540 parameter roles (which of a2/a3/a4/a5 are x/y/width/height and which pair is source versus destination) and its unusual returning of a5 while using it as an output pointer are not established.
The 0x00541CA0 bit-3 flag and the Camera flag byte both live at this+0x80 but common ownership is not proven; they are modeled as separate classes (RenderStateFlags vs Camera).

The shared this+0xEC flag field used by 0x00543A80 (bits 0x4, 0x10800) and 0x00544740 (bit 0x100000) suggests a possible common owner with multiple flag bits, but the packet does not prove it; they are kept in separate classes.

The trigger for allocating the fallback emitters (this+0xEC bit 0x4) is read by 0x00543A80 but its writers are outside the function; both fallback emitters are registered with the same parameter set (dword_8B8DF4 twice, dword_8B8DF8, constant 262152).
The object linked list headed by dword_8B8F14 walked by 0x005427D0 and the exact roles of its a2/a3/a4 parameters and the expected count dword_8B6AC0 are not established.

The role of the count-header/pointer-minus-4 free base in the sub-buffer descriptor (0x00541420) and what the two ObjectResetWithVirtualRelease targets at +0 and +36 represent are inferred only from the sibling call pattern.

EmptyStub_0170 invoked by 0x005437E0 is referenced only by name in the raw source; the packet records no address for it. The concrete contract of 0x0053CAF0 (refcount decrement versus free) is not established.
The exact matrix-element semantics of the D3D projection convention (row versus column major) are not resolved from the packet alone.
The success/failure convention of 0x005429B0 (0 on success, -1 on error) is observed only locally and is not corroborated by caller context in this packet.

The v8/v10 emitter object layout used by 0x005429B0 (flag dword at index 6, stream/connect fields at indices 7, 8, 11, 12) is not a packet field; the per-bit meanings of the a6 flags (0x800, 0x800000, 0x4000, 0x1000000) are inferred from usage rather than evidenced.
